claim_limits: M4A, M4B and M4C are not implemented. impact, versioned edits and history restore remain 404 and are asserted so by the integrity gate against src/host/server.ts.
evidence:wave1:integrity exits 1 by design: it asserts no code moved after the Wave 1 freeze, and Wave 2 moved code. Its output is kept verbatim and was never tuned green.
evidence:wave1:historical exits 0 and reads the frozen commit's tree rather than the tip.
The full gate runs at maxWorkers=2. That changes nothing about what is asserted, how long a test may take, or which tests run; it was chosen because this machine cannot sustain every suite at once.

HOST_RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED (503, ADR-W2.0-003) means a host resource was momentarily unavailable and the request may be retried. It is deliberately distinct from MEDIA_TOOL_UNAVAILABLE, which is a media-tool failure.
MT-05's lease timing uses an injected clock and a manual scheduler rather than sleeping, so a wall-clock lease test cannot be skipped on a busy machine or fail on a slow one.
PR-03 is closed on LockService: the control revision moves because a lock moved. No test writes a control revision by hand to stand in for a lock.
headed/human experience is NOT_RUN: this wave changes no UI.
Two guards are defence-in-depth and not independently provable, and are recorded rather than given contrived tests: the produced-frame-count check after encoding, and semaphore release idempotence.
The capture at 14cc3b6 is a FAILED diagnostic capture, kept deliberately; its directory says so. It is the evidence the two root causes were written against.
